name: Battle Live: Festival Live
source:
A new school year has begun at Pride Park -- the third years have graduated, and new first years have joined -- and that means it's time for one of the most anticipated events for the students; the annual School Festival!

Everyone's preparing their activities and performances, though it seems like a certain duo begin to reminisce about how Pride Park changed their lives for the better...

[From [url=https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/battle-live-festival-live] itch.io[/url]]
